summary: Radar for 16 Oct 2026 (GLP-1 focus). Four new stories checked out today. (1) The EU's medicines committee (CHMP) backed orforglipron (Foundayo) on Oct 16. Bloomberg, Endpoints, Reuters and Quartz all have it, and it fits our GLP-1 pill lane. (2) Fractyl's REMAIN-1 pivotal 6-month topline results came out Oct 16. Revita kept about 80% of the weight lost on a GLP-1 vs 67% with a sham procedure. These are company-reported numbers for a device that isn't authorized, and they give a fresh hook for "after stopping tirzepatide". (3) The bootleg retatrutide story keeps growing. Penn's Reddit and AI analysis is new: 13,589 self-reported users described increased appetite, fatigue, insomnia and a fast heart rate, which doesn't match the trial profile. AJC, Gizmodo, Medscape and the poison-center data all add to it. That suits our proven "what's confirmed vs not" warning lane. (4) Gray-market and compounded supply-chain news is clustering. FDA inspection findings at Chinese ingredient suppliers (Bloomberg, Oct 15), Medscape's photos of compounded products, the MHRA's £2M counterfeit-pen seizure and FDA warnings to online sellers all point the same way. Evergreen picks that keep their value: the SURMOUNT-5 side-effect head-to-head, strength training on tirzepatide (with a new review on protein and resistance training) and why responses differ. Lower priority: the Healio SELECT analysis (semaglutide-only titles underperform), observational findings on semaglutide and asthma/COPD and on tirzepatide and retinopathy, and surgery outcomes. The NAION or 'eye stroke' story is peaking and fear-driven, so it's a decoder only. Rejected: the NYT angle on anorexia in the GLP-1 era (eating-disorder risk, outside our guardrails) and the new semaglutide maintenance-dose story (dosing).

candidates.topic: What happens after stopping tirzepatide? SURMOUNT-4 regain data plus the new REMAIN-1 pivotal results (Revita kept ~80% of weight lost on GLP-1 therapy vs 67% with sham at 6 months, company-reported Oct 16)
